notes: Comparison lines (compare.<comparisonKey>) that curated cards use but the shared narration bank (client/public/data/journeys/src/narration.json) does not define. build_kb.ts adds a key, band or citation from here only when the bank lacks it, so the bank always wins. Voice: docs/sky-journeys/voice.md (start from the value and carry on in one flowing sentence; no meta-talk, no fragments). Placeholders {value}, {name}, {ratioPhrase} as documented in the bank. Period bands are shared by time.hours / time.days / time.years (the narrator picks the band from the period itself, so a curator's key choice cannot mislabel a 2-day cycle as 'hours').
